stem: Two products were sold in both Q2 and Q3. A pair of headphones sold 70 units at €120 each in Q2 and 80 units at €125 each in Q3. A TV wall mount sold 40 units at €60 each in Q2 and 50 units at €58 each in Q3. In Voltmarkt's margin bridge, the price effect adds up each product's change in price times its units in the later quarter. What is the price effect from Q2 to Q3? Give it in euros as a whole number.
